title: {{NAME}} and the Unicorn's Super Rescue
moral: Even the strongest hero needs a friend sometimes.

pages.content: {{NAME}} flew over a wide magical valley. Below were all kinds of animals. Elephants, parrots, and deer lived in the valley. A tall white unicorn with a shining horn stood on a hill. She was the guardian of the valley. Today something was wrong. A big grey cloud was stuck over the valley.
